args.body: Take SUPPLIER-COMPARER-COMMERCIAL-DIFFERENCE. The reported free competitor is a specific unresolved economic question about existing inventory. Produce the useful comparison itself, bounded to saved evidence and at most two official sources; do not generate another product or marketplace scan. The opaque deployment rejection remains parked under SUPPLIER-SHOPIFY-DEPLOY-REJECTED. Missing collection blocks paid acceptance, not this comparison. Unknown feedback must remain unknown; stop package preparation if no supported paid advantage emerges.

description: The supplier/Shopify prototype passed synthetic review, but three deployment attempts were refused with an undisclosed SiteError. That blocks this release, not independent work; retry only after a disclosed reason or qualifying independent approval. Feedback remains uncertain: three sources are unclassified, and no revenue is verified. Next, test whether the existing comparer offers a defensible paid outcome against the reported free alternative before preparing a sale package.
